title: HistoryCommand
responsibility: Registers Git history attach, status, reasons, prune, sync, build, and legacy report-import commands.

inputs.name: registerHistoryCommand.program
inputs.description: The Commander program that receives the new `history` subcommand, which the function adds by calling its `command` method with 'history'. It is required and not validated, so it must be a Commander Command instance that has that method.

outputs.name: registerHistoryCommand
outputs.description: The `history` subcommand that the function adds to the program, not the program itself, with attach, status, reasons, prune, fetch, push, sync, build and import-reports already registered on it before it returns. attach, status and reasons default --commit to HEAD, and build defaults --limit to '2000'.
